R04_email_shape.png.observation: The AI query ribbon is narrower than the Human configuration. Both reconstructions broaden it; the forest adds an upper Human excursion.

R04_review_shape.png.observation: The original AI ridge is narrow. Both models add dispersion; Human reconstructions introduce upper-tail excursions beyond the original query cloud.

R04_legal_shape.png.observation: Original class configurations overlap. Reconstructed responses broaden both classes, with larger Human upper-tail excursions in the forest display.

R04_abstracts_shape.png.observation: The original thin AI ribbon and Human tail organization are incompletely retained. The forest display adds large Human upper-tail excursions.

R04_articles_shape.png.observation: Some overall slope remains, while both models alter local spread and tails. Conditional energy improvement does not establish exact ribbon capture.

R04_papers_shape.png.observation: Only 23 queries per class. Both reconstructions spread mass into lower regions; this sheet is descriptive.

R06_email_anchors.png.observation: Query anchor positions are fixed in every column. Differences concern associated depth colours; anchor-cloud retention is not evidence of response capture.

R06_email_depth.png.observation: Models retain broad median-depth strata but add or reallocate maximum-depth levels. Grey full-context extremes are intentionally retained on the axes.

R06_review_anchors.png.observation: The AI anchor knot remains because the anchors are unchanged. Response-colour allocation differs, so persistence of the knot alone cannot validate a model.

R06_review_depth.png.observation: Human low-depth/median-one allocation is incompletely retained. AI reconstructions add median/maximum branches beyond the original query concentration.

R06_legal_anchors.png.observation: Human responses include higher depths than the AI cloud. Predicted colours only partly reproduce their allocation at the same anchors.

R06_legal_depth.png.observation: Higher Human median-depth branches are suppressed. A kernel draw also exposes a distant high-maximum reference response; all columns share its full range.

R06_abstracts_anchors.png.observation: Human high-depth colours are understated in several reconstructions. AI branch-associated colours differ despite similar anchor positions.

R06_abstracts_depth.png.observation: Human high maximum-depth allocation remains incomplete. AI reconstructions add upper or alternative levels; the lower energy score is not an occupancy certificate.

R06_articles_anchors.png.observation: The broad Human/AI anchor difference remains visible by construction, while response depth colours show partial allocation.

R06_articles_depth.png.observation: The observed Human median-three strand and AI median-two concentration are only partially represented; extra lower/alternative branches remain.

R06_papers_anchors.png.observation: Sparse descriptive cohort. Several predicted depth colours are lower or differently assigned than the observed values.

R06_papers_depth.png.observation: The predicted median/maximum strata do not fully recover the observed sparse paper branches. No primary recurrence conclusion is drawn.
